tasks.brief:
File: src/vortex/ui.py (EDIT — anchored SEARCH/REPLACE only; the coder receives the full current file). Change ONLY the client-JS field/shape/state reads named below; leave all CSS, element ids, fetch URLs, poll intervals, the escaping helper, and event wiring untouched.

1. Catalog envelope: GET /api/catalog returns {"entries": [...]}. In the catalog poll, render rows from data.entries, not from the response object itself.
2. Catalog entry fields (each entry: public_id, runtime, engine, port, ram_estimate_gb, ctx_size, state; NO id/name/size_gib). In the row renderer: model column shows m.public_id (was m.name); size column shows m.ram_estimate_gb (was m.size_gib); the load/unload button data-id uses m.public_id (was m.id).
3. Loaded-state token: a serving model's state is "ready" (never "loaded"). The row's loaded test becomes m.state === "ready"; the "loading" test is unchanged. Keep the existing loaded / loading CSS class names.
4. Status fields: GET /api/status returns ram_used_gb and ram_total_gb (GB, not _gib) and no ram_pct. The RAM meter reads s.ram_used_gb / s.ram_total_gb and computes the percent itself (total > 0 ? used / total * 100 : 0); the warn (>70) / danger (>85) zones and the label format are unchanged.
5. Operation handle: POST /api/models/{id}/load|unload returns {"operation": <id>, "model": <id>}. After a click, poll op.operation (was op.id).

Do NOT touch the conflict card (out of scope this delta). No new imports, no external assets, no print/logging. Acceptance: the five pinned field-contract tests pass and the carried ui_content tests still pass.

File: src/vortex/app.py (NO EDIT this delta — contracts-delta lists it in no_edit_files). This task exists only to carry the frozen route tests that pin the dashboard route and the unshadowed status route; make no code changes. Acceptance: the two pinned route tests pass against the existing app.
